async def act(page):
    # Navigate to the issues list page by clicking the first 'Issues' link under Project navigation
    issues_link = page.get_by_role("complementary", name="Project navigation").get_by_role("link", name="Issues").first
    await issues_link.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Click the 'New issue' button
    new_issue_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="New issue")
    await new_issue_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Fill the title field
    title_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Title (required)")
    await title_field.fill("add support for oh-my-zsh")
    
    # Assign the issue to Abishek
    assignee_combobox = page.get_by_role("combobox", name="Assignees")
    await assignee_combobox.click()
    await assignee_combobox.fill("Abishek")
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to appear
    await page.get_by_role("option", name="Abishek").click()
    
    # Set the due date to July 18 2033
    due_date_field = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Due date")
    await due_date_field.fill("2033-07-18")
    
    # Submit the issue
    submit_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Create issue")
    await submit_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
